y-m-62-02.title: Mangaphi amabini (a, b) enza kubekho ukuqhubeka?
y-m-62-02.goal: Usebenzisa imizekelo oyakhele ngokwakho, qinisekisa ukuba kukho ezininzi ngokungenamda, hayi ibini elinye kuphela, leekoyifishenti ezenza umsebenzi ochazwe ngamacandelo uqhubeke ku-x=1, uze ugwebe ukuba amabini ahlukaniswayo nawo ahluke njani.
y-m-62-02.material: Kwiimvakalisi eziqhelekileyo a no-b, chaza umsebenzi f ngolu hlobo (x linani lokwenyani). Ukuba x incinci kuno-1, f(x)=x isikwere ukongeza i-a ephindaphindwe nge-x (x²+ax), yaye ukuba x ubuncinane ngu-1, f(x)=2x+b. Ngezantsi, a no-b ziimvakalisi eziqhelekileyo ezizimeleyo.
y-m-62-02.thinking.1: Yakha izisombululo ezininzi uze uhlole imiqathango
y-m-62-02.prereq.1: Imeko yokuba umsebenzi uqhubeke ku-x=a (umda wasekhohlo = umda wasekunene = ixabiso lomsebenzi)
y-m-62-02.prereq.2: Ukwahlula imisebenzi ye-polynomial (x isikwere, iintetho ezithe tye)
y-m-62-02.prereq.3: Intsingiselo ye-derivative (amathambeka asekhohlo nasekunene kufuneka alingane ukuze iyahlukaniseka)
y-m-62-02.s.s1.prompt: Mangaphi amabini (a, b) enza ukuba i-f iqhubeke ku-x=1? Phambi kokuqala ukubala, khetha owona mgwebo ufanelekileyo.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala amaxabiso owafumana ngokufaka x=1 kwintetho yasekhohlo neyasekunene ku-x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuba mangaphi ulingano ngokwe-a no-b olunikwa yimeko yokuba amaxabiso amabini alingana.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.a: Likhona ibini elinye kuphela, apho zombini a no-b zimiselwe
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.a: Ucinge ukuba ekubeni kukho ezimbini ezingaziwayo amaxabiso amiselwe njengelinye. Bala ukuba ukuqhubeka kunika ulingano olungaphi.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.b: a no-b zimiselwe njengamabini amabini ahlukeneyo
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.b: Hlola apho izizathu zamabini amabini zivela khona. Jonga ukuba zingaphi ulingano nokuba zesiphi isidanga.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.c: Intetho yahlukile kwisithuba ngasinye, ngoko akukho bini lenza ukuba iqhubeke
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.c: Ucinge ukuba ekubeni intetho yahlukile kwisithuba ngasinye, azinakudityaniswa. Thelekisa amaxabiso eentetho ezimbini ku-x=1 ngqo.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.d: Kukho ulingano olunye kuphela, ngoko ukukhetha i-a kumisela i-b
y-m-62-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuze iqhubeke ku-x=1, umda wasekhohlo 1+a nexabiso lomsebenzi (umda wasekunene) 2+b kufuneka zilingane. Kukho olu lingano lunye kuphela, ngoko b=a−1, yaye ukuba ukhetha i-a ngokukhululekileyo, i-b iyamiselwa.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amabini amathathu ahlukeneyo (a, b) eenani eziphelele aqhubeka ku-x=1, nexabiso eliphelele le-a ubuninzi li-4.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ukhethe i-a enye uze ufumane ixabiso lentetho yasekhohlo ku-x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hlengahlengisa i-b ukuze ilingane nexabiso lentetho yasekunene.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Umda wasekhohlo 1+a nomda wasekunene (ixabiso lomsebenzi) 2+b ziyalingana.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Ku-x=1, ixabiso lentetho yasekhohlo 1+a nelentetho yasekunene 2+b alilingani.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.explain: Iqhubeka ukuba b=a−1 iyabamba. Imizekelo: (0, −1), (2, 1), (−3, −4). Ukuba i-a iyafana, i-b nayo iyafana, ngoko ukubala amabini ahlukeneyo, i-a kufuneka ihluke.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.prompt: Phakathi kwamabini owenzileyo ngoku, khetha ibango elichanekileyo ngamabini nawo ahlukaniseka ku-x=1. (Ukuze kuhlukaniseke ku-x=1, ii-derivative ezisuka ekhohlo nezisuka ekunene kufuneka zilingane.)
y-m-62-02.s.s3.hint.0: Hlukanisa intetho yecala apho i-x incinci kuno-1 uze ufumane ixabiso ku-x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuba ikho na i-a eyenza ilingane nethambeka lentetho yasekunene.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.a: Phakathi kwamabini aqhubekayo, ibini a=0, b=−1 kuphela elihlukanisekayo
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.b: Ukuba iqhubeka iyahlukaniseka, ngoko onke amabini owenzileyo ayafaneleka
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.b: Ucinge ukuba ukuqhubeka kuthetha ukwahlukaniseka. Fumana amathambeka asekhohlo nasekunene ngokwahlukileyo uze uwathelekise.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.c: Ufikelele esiphelweni ngaphandle kokuthelekisa amathambeka. Jonga ukuba ikho na i-a apho ithambeka lasekhohlo 2+a nelasekunene 2 zilingana.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.d: Xa i-a ikhula, ithambeka lasekhohlo 2+a nalo liyakhula yaye lihamba kude nelasekunene 2. Khangela ixabiso apho amathambeka alingana khona.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.explain: Ku-x=1, i-derivative yasekhohlo ngu-2·1+a=2+a kwaye eyasekunene ngu-2. Ukuze zilingane, a=0, yaye ukusuka kwimeko yokuqhubeka b=−1. Nokuba iqhubeka, amabini amaninzi aya kugobeka ku-x=1, ngoko awahlukaniseki.

y-m-62-01.title: Ukuhlola isisombululo esifumene umda ku-x=2
y-m-62-01.topic: Ukwahlula imida yasekhohlo neyasekunene nexabiso lomsebenzi
y-m-62-01.goal: Ngokufumana impazamo kwisisombululo, qinisekisa ukuba nokuba ixabiso lomsebenzi lichaziwe ku-x=2, lahlukile kwixabiso lomda, yaye ukuba imida yasekhohlo neyasekunene iyahluka, akukho mda.
y-m-62-01.material: Chaza umsebenzi f ngolu hlobo (x linani lokwenyani). Ukuba x incinci kuno-2, f(x)=x+1; ukuba x=2, f(2)=5; ukuba x inkulu kuno-2, f(x)=x isikwere ukuncitshiswa nge-1 (x²−1). Umsebenzi g: ukuba x incinci kuno-2, g(x)=x+1; ukuba x=2, g(2)=3; ukuba x inkulu kuno-2, g(x)=x isikwere (x²). Umfundi ubhale isisombululo sokufumana umda we-f xa i-x iya ku-2 njengoko kubonisiwe ngezantsi.
y-m-62-01.thinking.2: Gweba isiphelo xa imida yasekhohlo neyasekunene yahlukile
y-m-62-01.prereq.0: Ingcamango yolandelelwano lwesikolo: I-H2 kulo msebenzi sisinqanaba sobunzima kuphela kuyilo lwemveliso yaye ayithethi ukuba inikwe naliphi na ibanga lesikolo. Ijolise kubafundi sele bafundile izinto ezifunekayo ezingezantsi.
y-m-62-01.prereq.1: Intsingiselo yomda womsebenzi (ixabiso apho f(x) isondela kulo xa i-x isondela ku-a)
y-m-62-01.prereq.2: Intsingiselo yophawu lomda wasekhohlo nowasekunene (x isondela ku-a isuka kwicala elincinci kuno-a nasekucaleni elikhulu kuno-a)
y-m-62-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye kwisisombululo somfundi apho izizathu ziphosakele.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumgca ngamnye, phawula ukuba ixabiso elisetyenzisiweyo lifunyenwe apho i-x ingeyo-2 okanye lixabiso xa x=2.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba isiphelo somgca ngamnye sisuka ngqo kwisiphumo sokubala okwandulelayo, nokuba amaxabiso asetyenzisiweyo asuka phi.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.line.1: Xa i-x isondela ku-2, i-x ayingu-2, ngoko sebenzisa f(x)=x+1 kwicala elincinci kuno-2 kunye ne-f(x)=x²−1 kwicala elikhulu.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.line.2: Ukuya ku-2 usuka ekhohlo: umda we-x+1 ungu-3.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.line.3: Ukuya ku-2 usuka ekunene: umda we-x²−1 ungu-3.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.line.4: Imida yasekhohlo neyasekunene iyafana, ngoko umda uyakho, yaye ixabiso lawo yi-f(2)=5.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca 5 uphosakele. Kumgca 3 nowe-4, imida yasekhohlo neyasekunene zombini zingu-3, ngoko umda uyakho yaye ixabiso lawo ngu-3. Ixabiso lomda limiselwa ngamaxabiso ngelixa i-x isondela ku-2, yaye ixabiso lomsebenzi f(2)=5 ku-x=2 alingeni kolo bala. Ngoko kolu msebenzi ixabiso lomda 3 nexabiso lomsebenzi 5 ziyahluka.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.prompt: Ngoku jonga umsebenzi g. g(2)=3. Khetha eyona nkcazo ifanelekileyo ngomda we-g xa i-x iya ku-2.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ngokwahlukileyo amaxabiso apho i-g(x) isondela kuwo ukusuka kwicala apho i-x incinci kuno-2 nakwicala apho inkulu.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qala uthelekise ukuba amaxabiso amabini ayafana, uze emva koko ujonge i-g(2).
y-m-62-01.s.s2.o.a: Ixabiso lomsebenzi g(2)=3 lilingana nomda wasekhohlo 3, ngoko ixabiso lomda ngu-3
y-m-62-01.s.s2.r.a: Wagqiba umda ngenxa nje yokuba elinye ixabiso lasekhohlo lilingana nexabiso lomsebenzi. Ngaba ukhangele ixabiso elisondelwa ukusuka ekunene?
y-m-62-01.s.s2.o.b: Umndilili 3.5 womda wasekhohlo 3 nomda wasekunene 4 ngowona xabiso lomda
y-m-62-01.s.s2.r.b: Xa amaxabiso amabini ahlukile, uthathe ixabiso eliphakathi njengomda. Umda kufuneka ugxile kwixabiso elinye, ngoko jonga kwakhona imeko apho ikhohlo nekunene ziya kumaxabiso ahlukeneyo.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.o.c: I-g(2) ichazwe njenge-3, ngoko umda ungu-3
y-m-62-01.s.s2.r.c: Ithathe umda nexabiso lomsebenzi njengento enye. Khumbula ukuba kwi-f, umda 3 nexabiso lomsebenzi 5 zahlukile.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.o.d: Umda wasekhohlo ungu-3 nowasekunene ungu-4, eyahlukileyo, ngoko umda awukho ku-x=2
y-m-62-01.s.s2.explain: I-g isondela ku-3 isuka ekhohlo naku-4 isuka ekunene. Ukuba imida yasekhohlo neyasekunene iyahluka, ngoko nokuba i-g(2) ichaziwe, umda xa i-x iya ku-2 awukho.
y-m-62-01.s.s3.prompt: Kwi-g, nokuba ixabiso lomsebenzi g(2) likho, kwakungekho mda. Usebenzisa i-g njengomzekelo, bhala ngesivakalisi esinye okanye ezibini indlela umda nexabiso lomsebenzi eziyingcamango ezahlukileyo ngayo.
y-m-62-01.s.s3.hint.0: Unokusebenzisa amanani amabini owasebenzisileyo kwimida yasekhohlo neyasekunene ye-g njengoko injalo.
y-m-62-01.s.s3.hint.1: Qala ubhale izivakalisi ezimbini ecaleni kwesinye ngohlobo 'Umda lixabiso xa ..., yaye ixabiso lomsebenzi lixabiso ku-...'.
y-m-62-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale ukuba umda lixabiso xa i-x isondela ku-2, hayi ixabiso kwiphuzu x=2 ngokwalo?
y-m-62-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba usebenzise amanani emida yasekhohlo neyasekunene ye-g (3 no-4) njengezizathu?
y-m-62-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uphephile ukuthi umda kufuneka ubekho kuba nje ixabiso lomsebenzi likho?
y-m-62-01.s.s3.model.0: Umda lixabiso apho i-g(x) isondela kulo xa i-x isondela ku-2, yaye ixabiso lomsebenzi g(2) lixabiso lokwenyani ku-x=2. Nokuba g(2)=3, umda wasekunene ungu-4, ngoko ikhohlo nekunene ziyahluka yaye akukho mda.
y-m-62-01.s.s3.model.1: Ixabiso lomsebenzi lixabiso kuloo phuzu, yaye umda ukhona kuphela ukuba amaxabiso asondelwa ukusuka ekhohlo nasekunene ayafana, ngoko ahlukile. I-g iya ku-3 isuka ekhohlo naku-4 isuka ekunene, ngoko nangona i-g(2)=3 ikho, umda awukho.
y-m-62-01.s.s3.model.2: Isondela ku-3 isuka ekhohlo naku-4 isuka ekunene, ngoko umda awukho, kodwa i-g(2)=3 ichaziwe. Umda lixabiso elisondelwayo yaye ixabiso lomsebenzi lixabiso kuloo phuzu, ngoko zinokungabi nabudlelwane omnye komnye.
y-m-62-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Impendulo ebhalwe ngolu lungelelwano "nokuba akukho mda, kukho ixabiso lomsebenzi"

y-m-62-05.title: Zingaphi iimigca ethinteleyo ezinokuzotywa ukusuka kwichaphaza elingekho kwijika?
y-m-62-05.topic: Imigca ethinteleyo ezotywe ukusuka kwichaphaza elingaphandle kwejika
y-m-62-05.goal: Kumgca othinteleyo ozotywe ukusuka kwichaphaza elingekho kwijika, ichaphaza lokuchukumisa alaziwa, ngoko kufuneka ulithathe njengento engaziwayo uze umisele iimeko; qinisekisa ngomzekelo owakha ngokwakho ukuba zinokubakho imigca emininzi ethinteleyo.
y-m-62-05.material: Kukho ijika y=x² (x linani lenyani) kunye nechaphaza P(1, −3). Ukuba ikhowudinethi ye-x yechaphaza lokuchukumisa ngu-t, ichaphaza lokuchukumisa li-(t, t²), kwaye ithambeka lomgca othinteleyo apho li-2t, elifunyenwe ngokufaka x=t kwi-derivative 2x ye-y=x². Sifuna ukufumana u-t owenza lo mgca othinteleyo udlule kwichaphaza P.
y-m-62-05.thinking.0: Wahlula iimbopheleleko zechaphaza lokuchukumisa nechaphaza apho umgca udlula khona
y-m-62-05.thinking.2: Fumana izisombululo ezininzi uze ugwebe ukuba zingaphi
y-m-62-05.prereq.1: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-derivative nethambeka lomgca othinteleyo
y-m-62-05.prereq.2: Ulingano lomgca othinteleyo (kwichaphaza (t, f(t)) kwijika, y−f(t)=f′(t)(x−t))
y-m-62-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha indlela echanekileyo yokubhala njengolingano imeko 'umgca othinteleyo kwichaphaza lokuchukumisa (t, t²) udlula kwichaphaza P(1, −3)'.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kulingano lomgca othinteleyo y−t²=2t(x−t), faka iikhowudinethi zechaphaza P endaweni ka-x no-y.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuba icala lasekhohlo lolingano owufake kulo li-y−(ikhowudinethi ye-y yechaphaza lokuchukumisa) kwaye icala lasekunene li-thambeka×(x−ikhowudinethi ye-x yechaphaza lokuchukumisa).
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.a: Eli libinzana elithatha u-P njengechaphaza elikwijika kwaye lisebenzisa f(1)=1 endaweni yekhowudinethi ye-y. U-P akayichaphaza lokuchukumisa.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.b: Hlola ulandelelwano lwe-x−t xa ufaka x=1, y=−3 kulingano lomgca othinteleyo y−t²=2t(x−t).
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.d: Oku kumisela ithambeka lomgca othinteleyo libe li-2. Ithambeka litshintsha nendawo t yechaphaza lokuchukumisa.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.explain: Ulingano lomgca othinteleyo yi-y−t²=2t(x−t). Ukuba udlula kwichaphaza P(1, −3), ukufaka x=1, y=−3 kunika −3−t²=2t(1−t).
y-m-62-05.s.s2.prompt: Yenza imigca emibini ethinteleyo eyahlukileyo edlula kwichaphaza P, nganye inikwa yikhowudinethi ye-x t yechaphaza layo lokuchukumisa nethambeka lalo m.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kulingano olukwi-c2, faka ixabiso elinye lika-t uze ubale ukuba ukulingana kuyasebenza na.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ungatshintsha u-t uthelekise amacala amabini olingano, okanye ulungelelanise ulingano njengolingano ku-t uze ulucombulule.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Ithambeka m lahlukile kwi-derivative 2t kwichaphaza lokuchukumisa.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Lo mgca othinteleyo udlula kwichaphaza P(1, −3).
y-m-62-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Lo mgca othinteleyo awudluli kwichaphaza P(1, −3). Hlola ixabiso lika-y xa x=1.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.explain: Ukulungelelanisa −3−t²=2t(1−t) kunika t²−2t−3=0, oko kukuthi, (t−3)(t+1)=0, ngoko t=3 okanye t=−1. Zimbini imigca ethinteleyo: ithambeka 6 (ichaphaza lokuchukumisa (3, 9)) kunye nethambeka −2 (ichaphaza lokuchukumisa (−1, 1)).
y-m-62-05.s.s3.prompt: Thelekisa umgca othinteleyo ozotywe kwichaphaza (1, 1) kwijika neemigca ethinteleyo ezotywe ukusuka kwichaphaza P(1, −3). Amachaphaza okuchukumisa akuphi, mingaphi imigca ethinteleyo kwimeko nganye, nokuba kutheni ihluka? Yibhale ngesivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini.
y-m-62-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ithambeka kwi-(1, 1) lingafunyanwa ngokufaka x=1 kwi-derivative ye-y=x². Hlola ukuba eli chaphaza likwijika na.
y-m-62-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kuchaphaza P, ngenisa amachaphaza okuchukumisa owawenzileyo kwi-s2 uze uthelekise.

y-m-62-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubhale ukuba u-P akekho kwijika, ngoko amachaphaza okuchukumisa kufuneka afunyanwe ngokwahlukeneyo?
y-m-62-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba uthathe inani lemigca ethinteleyo kwiziphumo zokubala (t=3, t=−1)?
y-m-62-05.s.s3.model.0: (1, 1) lichaphaza elikwijika, ngoko elo chaphaza lichaphaza lokuchukumisa kwaye kukho umgca othinteleyo omnye (ithambeka 2). U-P akekho kwijika, ngoko amachaphaza okuchukumisa kufuneka afunyanwe ngokwahlukeneyo, kwaye t=3 no-t=−1 ziyaphuma, ngoko kukho imigca emibini ethinteleyo.

Kwichaphaza elikwijika, ezi zimbini ziyafana, ngoko umgca othinteleyo umiselwa njengomnye, kodwa kwichaphaza elingaphandle kwejika elinjenga-P, zimbini iindawo zokuchukumisa (x=3, x=−1), ngoko zimbini nemigca ethinteleyo.

y-m-62-04.title: Ukuba umda wethambeka elilinganiswe ngokulinganayo ukhona, ingaba uyahluka?
y-m-62-04.goal: Usebenzisa umzekelo ochasayo, qinisekisa ukuba nokuba 'umda womahluko olinganayo' ukhona kwi-x=a, i-derivative ayilazimeki ikhona, uze wahlule amacala amabini esitatimenti.
y-m-62-04.material: Isibakala sikaJinwoo: "Ukuba isiphumo sokwahlula (f(a+h)−f(a−h))/(2h) sinomda xa h ehamba ku-0, ngoko f iyahluka kwi-x=a." (Indlela yokufunda: f ka-a udibanise h ukhuphe f ka-a ukhuphe h, kwahlulwe ngo-2h.) Idatha engezantsi inikwa inyathelo ngenyathelo. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha ingcinga yakho ngesibakala.
y-m-62-04.thinking.0: Yazi imida yokugweba isitatimenti esiqhelekileyo ngomzekelo omnye
y-m-62-04.thinking.2: Jonga ngokwahlukeneyo ukuba icala lokuchasana lisebenza na
y-m-62-04.prereq.1: Ingcaciso ye-derivative (umda xa h→0 wesiphumo sokwahlula (f(a+h)−f(a))/h)
y-m-62-04.s.s1.prompt: Ujonge idatha, khetha ingcinga yakho malunga nesibakala sikaJinwoo kwinyathelo ngalinye.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala ngegama elinye ukuba idatha enikwe ngokutsha iyaxhasa isibakala, iyasishukumisa, okanye ikwenza uyeke ukugweba.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kwinyathelo lesi-3, bhala ngomnyama ukuba isibakala sihamba kuliphi icala ('umda ukhona ⇒ uyahluka'), uze ubhale nelinye icala ngokwahlukeneyo ukuthelekisa.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Kwi-f(x)=x² kunye no-a=1, (f(1+h)−f(1−h))/(2h) = ((1+h)²−(1−h)²)/(2h) = 4h/(2h) = 2. Lo mda ngu-2, kwaye f′(1) efunyenwe ngengcaciso nayo ngu-2.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Emva kokubona le datha, ucinga ntoni ngesibakala sikaJinwoo?
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kwi-x², amaxabiso amabini ayefana. Kodwa umzekelo omnye awunakugqiba isitatimenti esiqhelekileyo, ngoko 'sisenokuba sichanekile kodwa sifuna uvavanyo olungakumbi' kuyafaneleka.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Umzekelo omnye wawuchanekile, ngoko siqinisekisa ukuba isebenza kuyo yonke imisebenzi
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uqinisekise isitatimenti esiqhelekileyo ngomzekelo omnye ochanekileyo. Ukuba isebenza kuyo nayiphi na imisebenzi kufuneka kuvavanywe ngemizekelo eminye.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ichanekile kulo mzekelo, kodwa kufuneka sihlole ngakumbi ukuba isebenza nakwezinye imisebenzi na
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ixabiso elifanayo ukuphuma yingozi, ngoko isibakala sele singachanekanga
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uthathe ixabiso elifanayo ukuphuma njengengozi ngaphandle kwezizathu. Inyaniso yokuba ixabiso elifanayo liphumile nayo yinkcazelo.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Isibakala sibonakala sinokuchaneka, kodwa kusekudala ukusiqinisekisa ngalo mzekelo wodwa
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Kwi-f(x)=|x| kunye no-a=0, xa h engelilo u-0, (f(h)−f(−h))/(2h) = (|h|−|−h|)/(2h) = 0. Umda wesi siphumo sokwahlula ngu-0.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Umda wesiphumo sokwahlula esilinganayo ukhona kwaye ulingana no-0. Ukuba oku kuthetha ukuba f′(0) ikhona kufuneka kuhlolwe ngokwahlukeneyo ngengcaciso. Umfundi osele eyazi ukuba |x| iyagoba kwi-0 unokuthatha oku njengomzekelo ochasayo.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Umda u-0 ukhona, ngoko isibakala sichanekile, kwaye siqinisekisa ukuba f′(0)=0
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uthathe ubukho bomda wesiphumo sokwahlula njengobuthetha into enye ne-derivative ekhona. Ingaba uhlolile ngokufumana iithambeka ezisecaleni elinye ngokwengcaciso?
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ukugweba isibakala, kufuneka sihlole ngqo ukuba f′(0) ikhona ngokwengcaciso
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Igrafu ye-|x| iyagoba kwi-0, ngoko sele ndiyazi ukuba ayahluki, kwaye ndiyithatha njengomzekelo ochasayo wesibakala
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Umda uphume u-0, ngoko f idlula kwi-x=0 ithe tyaba
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Utolike isiphumo sokwahlula esilinganayo ngu-0 njengegrafu ethe tyaba. Khumbula imilo yegrafu ye-|x|.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ngokwengcaciso, (f(h)−f(0))/h = |h|/h. Ngu-1 xa h ekhulu kuno-0 kwaye ngu-−1 xa h encinci kuno-0, ngoko umda wasekunene ngu-1 kwaye umda wasekhohlo ngu-−1, kwaye f′(0) ayikho.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ngoku ugweba ntoni ngesibakala sikaJinwoo nocalo lwalo olungachasanga (ukuba f iyahluka, umda wesi siphumo sokwahlula esilinganayo ulingana no-f′(a))?
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.after: U-|x| ngumzekelo ochasayo, ngoko isibakala sikaJinwoo sixoki. Ngokuchasene, ukuba f iyahluka kwi-x=a, isiphumo sokwahlula esilinganayo sinokubonwa njengomndilili wezibini zokwahlula zethambeka, ngoko siya ku-f′(a). Inyaniso nobuxoki bahluka ngecala.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Isibakala sichanekile, kwaye u-|x| yinto ekhethekileyo engaqwalaselwa
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ulibale ukuba umzekelo omnye ochasayo uwisa isibakala. Isibakala sisitatimenti 'malunga nazo zonke ii-f'.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Isibakala sixoki. Icala eliphikisanayo kufuneka liqwalaselwe ngokwahlukeneyo
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Omabini amacala axoki, ngoko esi siphumo sokwahlula asinanto yokwenza ne-derivative
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ucinge ukuba umzekelo ochasayo kwelinye icala uwisa nelinye icala. Bala ngokwahlukeneyo ukuba esi siphumo sokwahlula siba yintoni xa f iyahluka.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Isibakala sixoki (umzekelo ochasayo |x|). Kwicala eliphikisanayo, ukuba f iyahluka, sinokuhlola ukuba ukubona isiphumo sokwahlula njengomndilili we-(f(a+h)−f(a))/h kunye (f(a−h)−f(a))/(−h) kunika f′(a)
y-m-62-04.s.s1.reflect: Ukuzithemba kwakho kwisibakala kwahluka njani phakathi kokuqala (x²) nokokugqibela (|x|)? 'Umzekelo wawuchanekile' wahluka njani kwi 'isebenza kuzo zonke iimeko'?
y-m-62-04.s.s2.prompt: Phinda uchaze isibakala sikaJinwoo kuye ngokuchanekileyo. Sebenzisa umzekelo ochasayo ukucacisa ukuba kutheni isibakala singasebenzi.

y-m-62-06.title: Ingaba i-extremum yasekhaya ifana neyona inkulu? Ukuhlola ukuya kwiziphelo zexesha
y-m-62-06.topic: Eyona inkulu neyona incinci kwixesha elivaliweyo
y-m-62-06.goal: Yakha umzekelo ochasayo kwisibakala sokuba eyona inkulu yasekhaya yeyona inkulu kuwo wonke ixesha elivaliweyo, uze ucacise ukuba iziphelo zexesha kufuneka zithelekiswe njengabakhethiweyo.
y-m-62-06.material: Cinga ngomsebenzi f(x)=x³−3x (x kwikhyubhu ukhuphe 3x) kwixesha −2 ≤ x ≤ 3. Ii-x ezine-f′(x)=3x²−3=0 zi-−1 no-1, kwaye f(−1)=2 no-f(1)=−2. UHajun wathi, "Kuloo xesha, eyona inkulu ka-f yi-maximum yasekhaya 2, kwaye eyona incinci yi-minimum yasekhaya −2."
y-m-62-06.thinking.0: Gweba ukuba isibakala sinyanisile okanye sixoki
y-m-62-06.prereq.1: Amachaphaza ane-f′(x)=0 afunyenwe nge-derivative nenyuko nenyuka yetheyibhile
y-m-62-06.s.s1.prompt: Kulungile ukuthi ugweba njani isitatimenti sikaHajun phambi kokwenza ibalo elingakumbi?
y-m-62-06.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana amaxabiso ngqo kuzo zombini iziphelo zexesha uze uwathelekise, ukubona ukuba i-maximum yasekhaya 2 likhulu kuno-f(x) kuzo zonke ii-x kuxesha.
y-m-62-06.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ingaba ikhona x, ngaphandle kweendawo ze-extrema zasekhaya, enokwenza u-f(x) abe mkhulu kuxesha.
y-m-62-06.s.s1.o.a: Kufuneka sithelekise namaxabiso kwiziphelo ezimbini zexesha
y-m-62-06.s.s1.o.b: I-maximum yasekhaya isoloko iyeyona inkulu yexesha, ngoko ichanekile
y-m-62-06.s.s1.r.b: Uthathe i-maximum yasekhaya njengeyona inkulu yexesha lonke. I-maximum yasekhaya isenokuba lelona xabiso likhulu kufutshane naloo chaphaza kuphela.
y-m-62-06.s.s1.o.c: I-extremum yasekhaya ayinakuba yeyona inkulu okanye incinci, ngoko ayichanekanga
y-m-62-06.s.s1.r.c: Zikho iimeko apho i-extremum yasekhaya iyeyona inkulu okanye incinci. Ukuba ubandakanya i-extrema yasekhaya ukusuka ekuqaleni, uphosisa abakhethiweyo.
y-m-62-06.s.s1.o.d: Zimbini i-extrema zasekhaya, ngoko asikwazi ukugweba
y-m-62-06.s.s1.r.d: Ucinge ukuba inani lamachaphaza liyawuvimba isigwebo. Cinga ngendlela yokufumana apho ixabiso likhulu kakhulu kuxesha.
y-m-62-06.s.s1.explain: I-extremum yasekhaya lelona xabiso likhulu okanye elincinci kuluhlu olusondeleyo kuphela. Kwixesha elivaliweyo, kufuneka uthelekise amachaphaza ane-f′(x)=0 kunye nazo zombini iziphelo zexesha njengabakhethiweyo.
y-m-62-06.s.s2.prompt: Njengemizekelo echasayo kwisibakala sikaHajun (eyona inkulu ngu-2), fumana uze ungenise ii-x ezintathu ezahlukeneyo kuxesha −2 ≤ x ≤ 3 apho f(x) likhulu kuno-2.
y-m-62-06.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana f(3) kwisiphelo sasekunene sexesha x=3 uze uyithelekise no-2.
y-m-62-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tshintsha u-x abe ngamaxabiso amakhulu kuno-2 uze ufumane apho f(x) igqitha khona kwi-2.
y-m-62-06.s.s2.explain: x³−3x−2=(x−2)(x+1)², ngoko f(x)>2 xa x>2 (kwi-x=−1 iyalingana). Kuxesha, 2<x≤3, kwaye kwi-x=3, f(3)=18. Ngoko eyona inkulu ayingu-2.
y-m-62-06.s.s3.prompt: Ukufumana eyona inkulu neyona incinci ka-f kweli xesha, bhala amaxabiso kwiziphi iindawo ekufuneka uzithelekise, nokuba kutheni zeziphi iindawo. Bhala namaxabiso abakhethiweyo bokwenyani.
y-m-62-06.s.s3.hint.0: Khumbula umzekelo ochasayo ovela kwi-s2 malunga nokuba f inokuba likhulu phi kwi-−2 ≤ x ≤ 3.
y-m-62-06.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala bonke abakhethiweyo kwitheyibhile uze ubeke amaxabiso ka-f ecaleni komnye.

y-m-62-06.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba ujonga kuphela i-extrema yasekhaya, ixabiso linokuba likhulu ekupheleni kwexesha, ngoko oko akwanelanga. y-m-62-07.title: Kwenzeka ntoni ukuba inani elingaphantsi lisondela ku-0 kodwa umda ukhona?
y-m-62-07.topic: Imida yamaqhezu anenani elingaphantsi eliba li-0, namakoyifishenti angekamiselwa
y-m-62-07.goal: Usebenzisa imeko efunekayo yokuba ukuba umda weqhezu elinenani elingaphantsi eliya ku-0 ukhona njengexabiso elipheleleyo, ngoko inani elingasentla naro liya ku-0, qinisekisa ukuba xa iimeko zingonelanga impendulo yimibini emininzi, kwaye xa kongezwa imeko imiselwa njengenye.
y-m-62-07.material: Kwiingxaki ezingatshintshiyo a no-b, cinga ngomda weqhezu (x²+ax+b)/(x−2) xa x ehamba ku-2. Inani elingaphantsi x−2 lisondela ku-0 xa x esondela ku-2. Okwangoku, konke esikwaziyo kukuba umda walo qhezu ukhona njengexabiso elithile lenyani.
y-m-62-07.thinking.1: Yakha izisombululo ezininzi kwimeko apho iimeko zingonelanga
y-m-62-07.thinking.2: Cacisa inkqubo apho imeko eyongeziweyo imisela isisombululo
y-m-62-07.prereq.1: Intsingiselo yomda womsebenzi nokubala amaxabiso emida
y-m-62-07.prereq.2: Imida kwiimeko apho ukwahlula abe zizinto ezibalayo nokurhoxisa kunokwenzeka
y-m-62-07.prereq.3: Izisombululo zikhangeleka njani xa kukho ulingano olunye lwezinto ezingaziwayo ezimbini
y-m-62-07.s.s1.prompt: Xa konke esikwaziyo yimeko yokuba umda ukhona njengexabiso lenyani, sesiphi isitatimenti esifanelekileyo kakhulu malunga no-a no-b?
y-m-62-07.s.s1.hint.0: Qwalasela okwenzeka kubukhulu beqhezu ukuba ixabiso lenani elingasentla lisondela kwinani elingengo-0 xa x esondela ku-2.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa umahluko phakathi kwemeko apho ixabiso lenani elingasentla liya kwinani elingengo-0 nemeko apho liya ku-0.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.a: Inani elingaphantsi lisondela ku-0, ngoko umda awunakubakho kuwo nawuphi a, b
y-m-62-07.s.s1.r.a: Ucinge ukuba xa inani elingaphantsi lisondela ku-0 lisoloko lihambela kude. Hlola ukuba, ukuba inani elingasentla nalo lisondela ku-0, zikho iimeko apho ukurhoxisa kunokwenzeka.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.b: Umda ukhona kuphela xa a no-b bobabini bengu-0
y-m-62-07.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba a=b=0, iba x²/(x−2) kwaye umda awukho. Faka uze ubone ngqo.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.c: Inani elisentla kufuneka libe ngu-0 kwi-x=2, ngoko b imiselwa ngu-a kwaye a ikhululekile
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.d: Zombini a no-b zimiselwe njengamaxabiso amnye
y-m-62-07.s.s1.r.d: Ucinge ukuba zombini izinto ezingaziwayo zimiselwe. Bala ukuba mingaphi izilingano ezinikwa yimeko yokuba umda ukho.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.explain: Ukuba inani elingaphantsi liya kwi-0 kwaye umda uphelele, inani elisentla kufuneka liye kwi-0 nalo. Ixabiso lenani elisentla kwi-x=2, 4+2a+b, kufuneka libe ngu-0, ngoko b=−4−2a. Kukho olu lingano olunye kuphela, ngoko a ikhululekile.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.prompt: Yenza iinqununu ezintathu ezahlukeneyo (a, b) apho umda ukhona kwaye ixabiso lomda likhulu kune-0.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ukhethe a enye ulungise b ukuze inani elisentla libe ngu-0 kwi-x=2.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.hint.1: Cima eli qhezu uhlole ukuba ixabiso lentetho esaleyo kwi-x=2 likhulu kune-0.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Inani elisentla ngu-0 kwi-x=2 (ixabiso lenani elisentla kwi-x=2, 4+2a+b, ngu-0).
y-m-62-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Inani elisentla alingu-0 kwi-x=2, ngoko umda awukho. Hlola ixabiso le-4+2a+b.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Ixabiso lomda alikhulu kune-0. Hlola ixabiso kwi-x=2 lentetho esaleyo x+2+a emva kokucima.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.explain: Ukuba b=−4−2a, ngoko inani elisentla x²+ax+b=(x−2)(x+2+a), ngoko emva kokucima ixabiso lomda li-4+a. Ukuze eli xabiso libe likhulu kune-0, a>−4. Imizekelo: (1, −6) inexabiso lomda lesi-5, (0, −4) inexabiso lomda lesi-4, (3, −10) inexabiso lomda lesi-7.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.prompt: Cinga ukuba kongezwa ulwazi lokuba ixabiso lomda lesi-5. Bhala ukuba (a, b) iba yintoni, uze ucacise ukuba kutheni ekuqaleni lingamiselwanga libe linye kodwa ngoku limiselwe.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.hint.0: Phinda ujonge kwinkcazo evela kwi-s2 indlela ixabiso kwi-x=2 lentetho esala emva kokucima elinxulumana ngayo nexabiso lomda.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba zingaphi iimeko ezifunekayo ukumisela zombini izinto ezingaziwayo.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.placeholder: Umzekelo: Ukuba ixabiso lomda lesi-5, ngoko ... ngoko (a, b)=...
y-m-62-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale ukuba ixabiso lomda lesi-5 linika ulingano 'ixabiso a+4 emva kokucima nokufaka x=2 lisi-5'?
y-m-62-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubhale ngokwahlukeneyo ulingano olunikwa yimeko yokuqala nolinikwa yimeko entsha?
y-m-62-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba uhlolile ixabiso b=−6 ukusuka kwimeko yokuba inani elisentla ngu-0 kwi-x=2?
y-m-62-07.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba ixabiso lomda lesi-5, ngoko a+4=5, ngoko a=1, kwaye inani elisentla kufuneka libe ngu-0, ngoko 4+2+b=0 no-b=−6. Ekuqaleni kwakukho ulingano olunye, ngoko a yayikhululekile, kodwa ngoku kukho izilingano ezimbini, ngoko zombini izinto ezingaziwayo zimiselwe.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.model.1: (a, b)=(1, −6). Imeko yokuba umda ukho inika ulingano olunye kuphela, kwaye ixabiso lomda lesi-5 linika olunye ulingano, a+4=5, ngoko ngoku kukho iimeko ezimbini kwaye imiselwe ibe nye.
